entities.summary: Zsolt Wintermantel is a Hungarian politician, who served as Mayor of Újpest from 2010 to 2019. Besides that he represented Újpest in the National Assembly of Hungary from 2010 to 2014. He was also Member of Parliament from the Budapest Regional List of Fidesz between 2004 and 2006, when he replaced Béla Glattfelder.
